records.statement: IRCC lists letter of acceptance, provincial/territorial attestation letter (or CAQ for Quebec), proof of identity, and proof of funds among documents commonly required for a study permit application. Applicability varies by situation.
records.excerpt: Get the right documents — letter of acceptance; provincial or territorial attestation letter; proof of identity; proof of funds.
records.humanReviewNotes: Descriptive citation only. Do not convert into automated eligibility rules without counsel review.

source.title: Study permit: Get the right documents

records.statement: IRCC states applicants must apply online for a study permit and, as of March 25, 2025, use the IRCC secure account for new study permits and extensions.
records.excerpt: As of March 25, 2025, you must use the IRCC secure account to apply for a new study permit or study permit extension.
records.humanReviewNotes: Operational process fact from IRCC page details date 2026-08-11 on source page at retrieval.

source.title: Apply online for a study permit

records.statement: IRCC Express Entry covers multiple economic programs including Canadian Experience Class, Federal Skilled Worker Program, and Federal Skilled Trades Program, each with distinct language, work experience, and job-offer rules. Exact thresholds must be taken from the current IRCC pages and are not embedded as product eligibility rules here.
records.excerpt: Who can apply — program-specific language skills, work experience, and job offer requirements differ by program under Express Entry.
records.humanReviewNotes: Overview only. CLB/TEER thresholds change and must not be hard-coded without approved curated rule package.

records.statement: IRCC ranks Express Entry profiles using the Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS). Language test results must be less than two years old. Proof-of-funds tables are updated periodically by IRCC.
records.excerpt: CRS ranks profiles; language tests less than two years old; proof of funds updated based on low income cut-off totals.
records.humanReviewNotes: Do not store CRS point tables in product rules without separate legal/editorial approval of current numbers.
